An '''iron dolabra''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[dolabra]], crafted from [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. It mines at speed 6 and has 500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_dolabra.json}}</ref>

As a [[dolabra]], it works as both a pickaxe and an axe, at a lower mining speed than the iron pickaxe or axe.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 6.

Its tool rules have no obsidian restriction, so it mines obsidian with drops at its normal speed, although the [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.1-alpha|1.12.1-alpha]] notes say only diamond, electrum and adamant tools can mine obsidian.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_dolabra.json}}</ref>

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 6 damage with an attack speed of 0.9.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>
